children: Vision Blue Resources Limited disclosed a 7.9% stake in USA Rare Earth, Inc. after receiving shares through the company’s merger with SVRE Holdings Ltd. on Sept. 3, 2026. The Schedule 13D, filed on Sept. 11, 2026, shows Vision Blue and its unit VB (Rare Earths) Limited now hold 29,544,227 common shares. The deal also gives the investor board representation tied to its ownership level.

Vision Blue, through VB (Rare Earths) Limited, secured the right to appoint one director to USA Rare Earth’s board as long as it owns at least 5% of the company. "VBRE has the right to designate one member to the Issuer's Board," and the company named Sir Mick Davis to the seat at closing.

The investor can sell shares under a resale registration filed on Sept. 4, 2026, and accepted transfer limits under a lock-up: one-third of shares are freely tradable at closing, another third unlock after 90 days, and the rest after 180 days. The firm may buy more or sell shares in the future as it evaluates USA Rare Earth’s performance and other opportunities.

Vision Blue Resources Limited is a Guernsey-based investment firm focused on strategic metals and minerals. The firm, founded by mining executive Sir Mick Davis, targets critical materials needed for the energy transition. Vision Blue typically partners with portfolio companies by providing growth capital and board-level guidance.
